PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Sonarpur Branch

Date: 06.10.2026

To,
Sunita Hansda
48, Kali Mandir Lane, Sonarpur, West Bengal - 700150

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 612336642594

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 2 EMI(s) of Rs. 6,120/- each in your above loan account are overdue since 30.07.2026. The total overdue amount is Rs. 12,240/-, and penal interest of Rs. 490/- has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay Rs. 12,730/- on or before 16.10.2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 28.10.2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
